mechanisms.name: unattended-upgrades
mechanisms.risk: kernel and desktop packages can terminate active processes

mechanisms.name: apt-daily
mechanisms.risk: package indexes and package actions can race active work

mechanisms.name: snap refresh
mechanisms.risk: desktop/runtime components can change outside LifeOS process control

mechanisms.name: kernel install
mechanisms.risk: a reboot changes the shared kernel and ends processes while durable state remains

desktop_breaking_packages.why: A kernel install can require reboot and changes the shared-kernel execution boundary.
Snap refresh scheduling can replace desktop/runtime components during active work.
Desktop account-service changes can disrupt the shell and session surfaces.

incident_reference.summary: The update path ended processes during reboot while the durable filesystem remained intact.
